description: The web guard's first load in a new browser: viewer with the probe's Kid role, then viewer2 (not managed). A reload with the browser's cached /Me answers removed (an init script) puts jfar-pending on <html> before the bundles run (the server manages someone) and /Me (held 1.5 s) clears it; with /Me held 4.5 s jfar-pending goes at 3 s while /Me hasn't answered, and the late answer is applied and cached, so a typed locked URL then ends on Home (a /Me slower than 3 s once turned the guard off); with the ClientScript held 12 s the head lifts its own jfar-pending at 3 s (it once stayed until the script ran); viewer2 signing in after a sign-out without a reload gets jfar-pending from the guard itself while its /Me is held, then no class at all, and its Managed false is cached. Reads only.

steps.name: sign in as viewer
the guard has viewer's /Me
viewer's answer is cached
an init script: no cached answer at load, and <html>'s classes recorded at DOMContentLoaded
steps.initScript: (() => { Object.keys(localStorage).filter((k) => k.indexOf('jfar:rules:') === 0).forEach((k) => localStorage.removeItem(k)); window.__jfarFirst = { dom: null }; document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { window.__jfarFirst.dom = document.documentElement.className; }); })()

steps.name: hold /Me 1.5 s
reload
jfar-pending was on <html> at DOMContentLoaded, before any lock class
the classes then
pending, no lock yet
/Me answered: the locks set, jfar-pending gone
hold /Me 4.5 s
reload (no cached answer: the init script)
jfar-pending goes at 3 s while /Me hasn't answered
when it was lifted
the late answer is applied and cached
stop holding /Me
a typed locked URL later in the same page life
steps.script: location.hash = '#/mypreferenceshome'; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); return location.hash;

steps.name: it ended on Home

an init script: <html>'s jfar-pending and whether Access Roles' ClientScript has run (its own entry in the kit's shared window.__jfkit: another kit plugin's script sets the global), every 250 ms from the document's start
steps.initScript: (() => { const t0 = performance.now(); window.__jfarSamples = []; const tick = () => { try { window.__jfarSamples.push([Math.round(performance.now() - t0), document.documentElement.classList.contains('jfar-pending'), !!(window.__jfkit && window.__jfkit.jfar)]); } catch (e) { } if (performance.now() - t0 < 16000) setTimeout(tick, 250); }; tick(); })()

steps.name: hold the ClientScript 12 s
reload with the script held
stop holding the ClientScript
jfar-pending over time while the ClientScript was held (its changes only)
steps.eval: window.__jfarSamples.filter((x, i, a) => i === 0 || a[i - 1][1] !== x[1] || a[i - 1][2] !== x[2])

steps.name: the head set jfar-pending and lifted it itself after 3 s, long before the ClientScript ran
steps.assert: (() => { const s = window.__jfarSamples; const on = s.find((x) => x[1]); const off = on && s.find((x) => x[0] > on[0] && !x[1]); return !!on && !!off && off[0] <= 3600 && off[2] === false && s.some((x) => x[0] >= 6000 && !x[2]); })()

steps.name: the guard is up again, with viewer's /Me
hold /Me 1.5 s again, for viewer2's sign-in
sign out without a reload
steps.script: await ApiClient.logout(); Dashboard.navigate('login'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return location.hash;

steps.name: signed out: no lock class left
sign in as viewer2 on the same page (no reload)
jfar-pending while viewer2's /Me is held
viewer2's /Me answered: no class, Managed false cached
the guard set jfar-pending itself for the new user, and cached Managed false
stop holding /Me
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
